create_schema_class: create a frozen attrs schema class with typed fields and default values using the schema decorator
parse_dict_to_schema: parse a dictionary into a typed Schema instance using Schema.from_dict with automatic type coercion
serialize_schema_to_dict: serialize a Schema instance back to a dictionary using the to_dict method with type mapping
create_custom_mapper: create a custom Mapper subclass to define how bool and enum types are mapped during schema parsing
validate_nested_config: validate and extract nested types from a Schema class using extract_nested_type with a dot-separated path
